                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><h2 data-id="heading-0">一、背景与目标</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">1.1 什么是"秒开"</h3>
<p>App 内嵌 H5 的"秒开"指用户点击后，H5 页面在 <strong>毫秒级（理想 &lt; 300ms）内完成首屏渲染</strong>，用户感知不到明显的白屏或加载过程，体验接近 Native 页面切换。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">1.2 为什么 H5 加载慢</h3>






























<table><thead><tr><th>阶段</th><th>耗时占比</th><th>瓶颈</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>WebView 初始化</td><td>100~300ms</td><td>首次创建 WebView 需加载内核</td></tr><tr><td>网络请求 (HTML)</td><td>200~2000ms</td><td>DNS、TCP、SSL、传输</td></tr><tr><td>资源加载 (JS/CSS/图片)</td><td>500~3000ms</td><td>请求数量、体积、CDN</td></tr><tr><td>JS 执行 &amp; 渲染</td><td>200~1000ms</td><td>框架初始化、DOM 构建</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">1.3 秒开的核心思路</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs">秒开 = 消除网络延迟 + 预加载 + 渲染优化
</code></pre>
<p><strong>关键原则</strong>：把"用户点击后"做的事情，尽量提前到"用户点击前"完成。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-4">二、整体架构</h2>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css">┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        App 原生层                         │
│  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌───────────────────┐  │
│  │ 离线包    │  │ WebView      │  │  预加载 / 预热     │  │
│  │ 管理模块  │  │ 容器管理     │  │  模块             │  │
│  └──────────┘  └──────────────┘  └───────────────────┘  │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                      <span class="hljs-selector-tag">H5</span> 前端层                            │
│  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌───────────────────┐  │
│  │ 骨架屏    │  │  接口预请求  │  │  资源懒加载       │  │
│  │ /SSR     │  │  /缓存策略   │  │  /代码分割        │  │
│  └──────────┘  └──────────────┘  └───────────────────┘  │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                      服务端                               │
│  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌───────────────────┐  │
│  │ 离线包    │  │  CDN         │  │  增量更新         │  │
│  │ 分发服务  │  │  加速        │  │  服务             │  │
│  └──────────┘  └──────────────┘  └───────────────────┘  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-5">三、H5 离线包技术（核心）</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">3.1 基本原理</h3>
<p>将 H5 页面的静态资源（HTML、JS、CSS、图片等）预先打包下载到 App 本地，当用户访问 H5 页面时，<strong>拦截 WebView 的网络请求，直接从本地文件系统读取资源返回</strong>，从而消除网络延迟。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs">传统加载：  WebView → DNS → TCP → SSL → CDN → 下载资源 → 渲染
离线包加载：WebView → 本地拦截 → 读取本地文件 → 渲染（零网络开销）
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-7">3.2 离线包架构设计</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-markdown" lang="markdown">┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              离线包管理平台（服务端）          │
│  ┌─────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────────┐  │
│  │ 包构建  │ │ 版本管理 │ │  灰度/全量发布 │  │
│  └─────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────────┘  │
└────────────────────┬────────────────────────┘
<span class="hljs-code">                     │ 下发
┌────────────────────▼────────────────────────┐
│              App 离线包 SDK（客户端）          │
│  ┌─────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────────┐  │
│  │ 下载更新 │ │ 版本校验 │ │ 资源拦截器    │  │
│  └─────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────────┘  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
</span></code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">3.3 离线包格式</h3>
<p>推荐使用 ZIP 压缩包，包含以下结构：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-python" lang="python">offline_package_v1<span class="hljs-number">.2</span><span class="hljs-number">.3</span>.<span class="hljs-built_in">zip</span>
├── manifest.json          <span class="hljs-comment"># 资源清单（文件路径→hash映射）</span>
├── index.html
├── static/
│   ├── js/
│   │   ├── vendor.<span class="hljs-built_in">hash</span>.js
│   │   └── app.<span class="hljs-built_in">hash</span>.js
│   ├── css/
│   │   └── app.<span class="hljs-built_in">hash</span>.css
│   └── img/
│       └── logo.<span class="hljs-built_in">hash</span>.png
└── config.json             <span class="hljs-comment"># 包配置（版本、依赖等）</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>manifest.json 示例：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-json" lang="json"><span class="hljs-punctuation">{</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">"version"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-string">"1.2.3"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">"packageId"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-string">"home_page"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">"minAppVersion"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-string">"3.0.0"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">"resources"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">"/index.html"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-string">"a1b2c3d4e5f6..."</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">"/static/js/vendor.hash.js"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-string">"b2c3d4e5f6a1..."</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">"/static/js/app.hash.js"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-string">"c3d4e5f6a1b2..."</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">"/static/css/app.hash.css"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-string">"d4e5f6a1b2c3..."</span>
  <span class="hljs-punctuation">}</span>
<span class="hljs-punctuation">}</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">3.4 资源拦截方案</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-10">Android 方案：<code>shouldInterceptRequest</code></h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// WebViewClient 中拦截资源请求</span>
<span class="hljs-meta">@Override</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> WebResourceResponse <span class="hljs-title function_">shouldInterceptRequest</span><span class="hljs-params">(WebView view, WebResourceRequest request)</span> {
    <span class="hljs-type">String</span> <span class="hljs-variable">url</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> request.getUrl().toString();
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 检查是否命中离线包</span>
    <span class="hljs-type">OfflineResource</span> <span class="hljs-variable">resource</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> OfflinePackageManager.getInstance()
        .findResource(url);
    
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (resource != <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 从本地读取并返回</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
            <span class="hljs-type">InputStream</span> <span class="hljs-variable">is</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">FileInputStream</span>(resource.getLocalPath());
            <span class="hljs-type">String</span> <span class="hljs-variable">mimeType</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> getMimeType(url);
            <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">WebResourceResponse</span>(mimeType, <span class="hljs-string">"UTF-8"</span>, is);
        } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (IOException e) {
            <span class="hljs-comment">// 降级到网络请求</span>
        }
    }
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 3. 未命中，走正常网络请求</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">super</span>.shouldInterceptRequest(view, request);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-11">iOS 方案：<code>WKURLSchemeHandler</code> / <code>NSURLProtocol</code></h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-swift" lang="swift"><span class="hljs-comment">// 注册自定义 scheme，如 "offline://"</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> config <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-type">WKWebViewConfiguration</span>()
config.setURLSchemeHandler(<span class="hljs-type">OfflineSchemeHandler</span>(), forURLScheme: <span class="hljs-string">"offline"</span>)

<span class="hljs-comment">// 拦截处理</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">OfflineSchemeHandler</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">NSObject</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">WKURLSchemeHandler</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">func</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">webView</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">_</span> <span class="hljs-params">webView</span>: <span class="hljs-type">WKWebView</span>, <span class="hljs-params">start</span> <span class="hljs-params">urlSchemeTask</span>: <span class="hljs-type">WKURLSchemeTask</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">guard</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> url <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> urlSchemeTask.request.url <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> { <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> }
        
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> localPath <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-type">OfflinePackageManager</span>.shared.localPath(for: url) {
            <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> data <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">try?</span> <span class="hljs-type">Data</span>(contentsOf: <span class="hljs-type">URL</span>(fileURLWithPath: localPath))
            <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> response <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-type">URLResponse</span>(url: url, mimeType: mimeType, 
                                        expectedContentLength: data<span class="hljs-operator">?</span>.count <span class="hljs-operator">??</span> <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, 
                                        textEncodingName: <span class="hljs-string">"utf-8"</span>)
            urlSchemeTask.didReceive(response)
            urlSchemeTask.didReceive(data <span class="hljs-operator">??</span> <span class="hljs-type">Data</span>())
            urlSchemeTask.didFinish()
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">3.5 版本更新策略</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs">┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   版本更新流程                         │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                      │
│  App启动 ──→ 检查离线包更新接口                       │
│                │                                     │
│                ├── 无更新 → 使用本地版本              │
│                │                                     │
│                └── 有更新                             │
│                      │                               │
│                      ├── 全量包 → 下载新 ZIP 替换     │
│                      │                               │
│                      └── 增量包 → 下载 patch + 合并   │
│                                                      │
│  核心策略：                                           │
│  1. 启动时异步检查更新，不阻塞主流程                  │
│  2. 增量更新优先（bsdiff/Google Diff Patch）         │
│  3. 新包下载完成后，下次启动生效（非强制即时替换）     │
│  4. 保留最近 2 个版本，支持回滚                       │
│                                                      │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
</code></pre>
<p><strong>增量更新（bsdiff）：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">旧包(v1.<span class="hljs-number">2.2</span>) + patch文件 → 新包(v1.<span class="hljs-number">2.3</span>)

增量包大小 = 新包与旧包的二进制差分
典型压缩比：<span class="hljs-number">1</span>MB全量 → <span class="hljs-number">50</span>~<span class="hljs-number">200</span>KB增量
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-13">3.6 预加载策略</h3>






























<table><thead><tr><th>策略</th><th>描述</th><th>适用场景</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>静默下载</strong></td><td>App 空闲时后台下载离线包</td><td>首页、核心页面</td></tr><tr><td><strong>WiFi 优先</strong></td><td>仅在 WiFi 下下载大离线包</td><td>包体积 &gt; 5MB</td></tr><tr><td><strong>WiFi 预下载</strong></td><td>WiFi 下新包就绪时立刻更新</td><td>所有离线包</td></tr><tr><td><strong>懒加载</strong></td><td>用户首次访问某页面时才下载</td><td>低频页面</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-14">四、WebView 容器优化</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-15">4.1 WebView 预热池</h3>
<p>WebView 的首次初始化是最耗时的环节（100~300ms），通过预热池技术消除初始化开销：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">WebViewPool</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">static</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> <span class="hljs-type">int</span> <span class="hljs-variable">POOL_SIZE</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-number">2</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> Queue&lt;WebView&gt; pool = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">LinkedList</span>&lt;&gt;();
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// App 启动时预创建 WebView</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">preload</span><span class="hljs-params">(Context context)</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-type">int</span> <span class="hljs-variable">i</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; POOL_SIZE; i++) {
            <span class="hljs-type">WebView</span> <span class="hljs-variable">webView</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">WebView</span>(context);
            webView.loadUrl(<span class="hljs-string">"about:blank"</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 触发内核初始化</span>
            pool.offer(webView);
        }
    }
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 获取预热的 WebView</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> WebView <span class="hljs-title function_">acquire</span><span class="hljs-params">(Context context)</span> {
        <span class="hljs-type">WebView</span> <span class="hljs-variable">webView</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> pool.poll();
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (webView == <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>) {
            webView = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">WebView</span>(context);
        }
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> webView;
    }
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 归还</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">recycle</span><span class="hljs-params">(WebView webView)</span> {
        webView.loadUrl(<span class="hljs-string">"about:blank"</span>);
        webView.clearHistory();
        pool.offer(webView);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>关键配置：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// WebView 优化设置</span>
<span class="hljs-type">WebSettings</span> <span class="hljs-variable">settings</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> webView.getSettings();

<span class="hljs-comment">// 启用缓存</span>
settings.setCacheMode(WebSettings.LOAD_DEFAULT);
settings.setDomStorageEnabled(<span class="hljs-literal">true</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 渲染优化</span>
settings.setRenderPriority(WebSettings.RenderPriority.HIGH);
settings.setLoadWithOverviewMode(<span class="hljs-literal">true</span>);
settings.setUseWideViewPort(<span class="hljs-literal">true</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 废弃不必要的特性</span>
settings.setSupportZoom(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
settings.setBuiltInZoomControls(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-16">4.2 模板预热</h3>
<p>提前加载一个带"空壳"HTML 模板的 WebView：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-html" lang="html"><span class="hljs-comment">&lt;!-- preload_template.html --&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-meta">&lt;!DOCTYPE <span class="hljs-keyword">html</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">html</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">head</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">meta</span> <span class="hljs-attr">charset</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"utf-8"</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">meta</span> <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"viewport"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">content</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">script</span>&gt;</span><span class="javascript">
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 预加载 JS Bridge</span>
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">JSBridge</span> = { <span class="hljs-comment">/* ... */</span> };
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 预留数据注入接口</span>
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">__PRELOAD_DATA__</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
    </span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">script</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">&lt;!-- 只引入核心框架 JS（如 Vue/React 运行时） --&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">script</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"offline://static/js/core.hash.js"</span>&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">script</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">head</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">body</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"app"</span>&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">body</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">html</span>&gt;</span>
</code></pre>
<p>用户访问时，App 只需通过 <code>evaluateJavascript</code> 注入数据并触发渲染：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-type">String</span> <span class="hljs-variable">pageData</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> getPreloadedData(pageUrl);
webView.evaluateJavascript(
    <span class="hljs-string">"window.__PRELOAD_DATA__ = "</span> + pageData + <span class="hljs-string">"; "</span> +
    <span class="hljs-string">"app.render();"</span>, 
    <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>
);
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-17">五、数据预加载</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-18">5.1 接口预请求</h3>
<p>在 App 层提前发起 API 请求，数据就绪后再打开 H5：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// App 层预请求数据</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">openH5WithPreload</span><span class="hljs-params">(String pageUrl, String apiUrl)</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 先发起 API 请求（Native 层网络请求更快）</span>
    apiService.fetch(apiUrl, <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Callback</span>() {
        <span class="hljs-meta">@Override</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onSuccess</span><span class="hljs-params">(String data)</span> {
            <span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 接口返回后再打开 WebView</span>
            <span class="hljs-type">WebView</span> <span class="hljs-variable">webView</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> webViewPool.acquire(context);
            webView.loadUrl(pageUrl + <span class="hljs-string">"?preload_data="</span> + encode(data));
            <span class="hljs-comment">// 或者通过 JSBridge 注入</span>
            webView.evaluateJavascript(
                <span class="hljs-string">"window.__preloadData = "</span> + data, <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>
            );
        }
    });
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-19">5.2 客户端缓存策略</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-yaml" lang="yaml"><span class="hljs-string">┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>              <span class="hljs-string">数据缓存层次</span>                     <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-attr">L1:</span> <span class="hljs-string">内存缓存（秒级）</span>                        <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>      <span class="hljs-bullet">-</span> <span class="hljs-string">页面切换时保留上一页数据</span>               <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>      <span class="hljs-bullet">-</span> <span class="hljs-string">适用于返回场景</span>                        <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>                                             <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-attr">L2:</span> <span class="hljs-string">本地存储（分钟~天）</span>                      <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>      <span class="hljs-bullet">-</span> <span class="hljs-string">SQLite</span> <span class="hljs-string">/</span> <span class="hljs-string">SharedPreferences</span> <span class="hljs-string">/</span> <span class="hljs-string">MMKV</span>    <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>      <span class="hljs-bullet">-</span> <span class="hljs-string">缓存</span> <span class="hljs-string">API</span> <span class="hljs-string">响应数据</span>                     <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>      <span class="hljs-bullet">-</span> <span class="hljs-string">缓存用户偏好</span>                          <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>                                             <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-attr">L3:</span> <span class="hljs-string">离线包（静态资源）</span>                       <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>      <span class="hljs-bullet">-</span> <span class="hljs-string">本地文件系统</span>                          <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>      <span class="hljs-bullet">-</span> <span class="hljs-string">HTML/JS/CSS/图片</span>                     <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-20">5.3 H5 侧缓存策略</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// Service Worker 缓存（支持 SW 的 WebView）</span>
self.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'fetch'</span>, <span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">event</span> =&gt;</span> {
    event.<span class="hljs-title function_">respondWith</span>(
        caches.<span class="hljs-title function_">match</span>(event.<span class="hljs-property">request</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">cached</span> =&gt;</span> {
            <span class="hljs-comment">// 缓存优先，后台更新</span>
            <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> fetchPromise = <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(event.<span class="hljs-property">request</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">response</span> =&gt;</span> {
                <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> clone = response.<span class="hljs-title function_">clone</span>();
                caches.<span class="hljs-title function_">open</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'v1'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">cache</span> =&gt;</span> cache.<span class="hljs-title function_">put</span>(event.<span class="hljs-property">request</span>, clone));
                <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> response;
            });
            <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> cached || fetchPromise;
        })
    );
});

<span class="hljs-comment">// 接口缓存</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ApiCache</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">static</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(<span class="hljs-params">key</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cache = <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">parse</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">localStorage</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getItem</span>(key) || <span class="hljs-string">'{}'</span>);
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (cache.<span class="hljs-property">expire</span> &gt; <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>()) {
            <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> cache.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>;
        }
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">static</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(<span class="hljs-params">key, data, ttl = <span class="hljs-number">300000</span></span>) { <span class="hljs-comment">// 5min</span>
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">localStorage</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setItem</span>(key, <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>({
            data,
            <span class="hljs-attr">expire</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>() + ttl
        }));
    }
}
</code></pre>

<h2 data-id="heading-21">六、H5 渲染优化</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-22">6.1 骨架屏（Skeleton Screen）</h3>
<p>在 HTML 中预置骨架屏结构，JS 执行完毕后替换为真实内容：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-html" lang="html"><span class="hljs-meta">&lt;!DOCTYPE <span class="hljs-keyword">html</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">html</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">head</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">style</span>&gt;</span><span class="css">
        <span class="hljs-comment">/* 骨架屏样式，首屏内联，0网络请求 */</span>
        <span class="hljs-selector-class">.skeleton-header</span> { <span class="hljs-attribute">height</span>: <span class="hljs-number">44px</span>; <span class="hljs-attribute">background</span>: <span class="hljs-number">#f0f0f0</span>; }
        <span class="hljs-selector-class">.skeleton-card</span> { <span class="hljs-attribute">height</span>: <span class="hljs-number">120px</span>; <span class="hljs-attribute">background</span>: <span class="hljs-number">#f0f0f0</span>; <span class="hljs-attribute">margin</span>: <span class="hljs-number">8px</span>; }
        <span class="hljs-selector-class">.skeleton-animate</span> { 
            <span class="hljs-attribute">background</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">linear-gradient</span>(<span class="hljs-number">90deg</span>, <span class="hljs-number">#f0f0f0</span> <span class="hljs-number">25%</span>, <span class="hljs-number">#e0e0e0</span> <span class="hljs-number">50%</span>, <span class="hljs-number">#f0f0f0</span> <span class="hljs-number">75%</span>);
            <span class="hljs-attribute">background-size</span>: <span class="hljs-number">200%</span> <span class="hljs-number">100%</span>;
            <span class="hljs-attribute">animation</span>: shimmer <span class="hljs-number">1.5s</span> infinite;
        }
        <span class="hljs-keyword">@keyframes</span> shimmer { <span class="hljs-number">0%</span> { <span class="hljs-attribute">background-position</span>: -<span class="hljs-number">200%</span> <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; } <span class="hljs-number">100%</span> { <span class="hljs-attribute">background-position</span>: <span class="hljs-number">200%</span> <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; } }
    </span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">style</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">head</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">body</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">&lt;!-- 骨架屏：用户看到的第一个画面 --&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"skeleton"</span>&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"skeleton-header skeleton-animate"</span>&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"skeleton-card skeleton-animate"</span>&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"skeleton-card skeleton-animate"</span>&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"app"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">style</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"display:none;"</span>&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">&lt;!-- 真实内容渲染完成后切换 --&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">script</span>&gt;</span><span class="javascript">
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">__showContent</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
            <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'skeleton'</span>).<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">display</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'none'</span>;
            <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'app'</span>).<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">display</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'block'</span>;
        };
    </span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">script</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">body</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">html</span>&gt;</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-23">6.2 首屏最小化原则</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css">首屏 <span class="hljs-selector-tag">HTML</span> 大小目标：
┌──────────────────────────┐
│  骨架屏 + 关键路径代码    │  &lt; <span class="hljs-number">14</span>KB (<span class="hljs-number">1</span> TCP round-trip)
│  - 内联首屏 CSS           │
│  - 内联最小 JS            │
│  - 延迟加载非关键资源      │
└──────────────────────────┘
</code></pre>
<p><strong>资源加载策略：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-html" lang="html"><span class="hljs-comment">&lt;!-- 关键资源：正常加载 --&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">link</span> <span class="hljs-attr">rel</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"stylesheet"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">href</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"offline://static/css/critical.css"</span>&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">script</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"offline://static/js/app.js"</span>&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">script</span>&gt;</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">&lt;!-- 非关键资源：延迟加载 --&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">link</span> <span class="hljs-attr">rel</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"preload"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">as</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"style"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">href</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"offline://static/css/non-critical.css"</span> 
      <span class="hljs-attr">onload</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"this.rel='stylesheet'"</span>&gt;</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">&lt;!-- 图片：懒加载 --&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">img</span> <span class="hljs-attr">data-src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"..."</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"lazyload"</span> /&gt;</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-24">6.3 JS 代码分割</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 按路由/页面分割代码</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">HomePage</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'./pages/HomePage.vue'</span>);
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">DetailPage</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'./pages/DetailPage.vue'</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 第三方库按需加载</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">loadEcharts</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-comment">/* webpackChunkName: "echarts" */</span> <span class="hljs-string">'echarts'</span>);
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-25">七、App 端完整接入流程</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-26">7.1 接入步骤</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css">第一阶段：基础接入
├── App 启动时初始化离线包 SDK
├── 启动 WebView 预热池（<span class="hljs-number">2</span>~<span class="hljs-number">3</span>个）
├── 注册离线资源拦截器
└── 接入离线包更新服务

第二阶段：核心页面离线化
├── 首页 <span class="hljs-selector-tag">HTML</span>/CSS/JS → 离线包
├── 核心图片 → 离线包（或预加载到本地）
├── 实现骨架屏
└── 接入 JSBridge 数据预请求

第三阶段：极致优化
├── 增量更新
├── 按场景预加载（用户画像）
├── 页面预渲染
└── 全链路监控
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-27">7.2 监控指标</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 关键性能指标</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> metrics = {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// WebView 容器耗时</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">webview_create</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,      <span class="hljs-comment">// WebView 初始化耗时</span>
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 资源加载耗时</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">resource_load</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,       <span class="hljs-comment">// 资源加载完成时间</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">offline_hit_rate</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,    <span class="hljs-comment">// 离线包命中率</span>
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 渲染耗时</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">first_paint</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,         <span class="hljs-comment">// 首次绘制 (FP)</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">first_contentful_paint</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 首次内容绘制 (FCP)</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">first_screen_ready</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,  <span class="hljs-comment">// 首屏可交互 (自定义)</span>
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 数据耗时</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">api_response</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,        <span class="hljs-comment">// 首屏接口耗时</span>
};
</code></pre>
<p><strong>上报时机：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 在 HTML &lt;head&gt; 最先执行</span>
&lt;script&gt;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">__PERF_START__</span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>();
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">__PERF_MARKS__</span> = {};
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 性能标记</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">__mark__</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span>(<span class="hljs-params">name</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">__PERF_MARKS__</span>[name] = <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>() - <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">__PERF_START__</span>;
    };
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;!-- 骨架屏渲染 --&gt;
<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">script</span>&gt;</span><span class="javascript"><span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">__mark__</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'skeleton_ready'</span>);</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">script</span>&gt;</span></span>

&lt;!-- <span class="hljs-title class_">App</span>核心<span class="hljs-variable constant_">JS</span>加载 --&gt;
<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">script</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"offline://static/js/app.js"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onload</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"window.__mark__('app_loaded')"</span>&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">script</span>&gt;</span></span>

&lt;!-- 首屏数据就绪 --&gt;
<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">script</span>&gt;</span><span class="javascript">app.<span class="hljs-title function_">onReady</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">__mark__</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'first_screen_ready'</span>));</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">script</span>&gt;</span></span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-28">八、进阶方案</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-29">8.1 页面预渲染</h3>
<p>在用户可能访问的页面之前，提前在<strong>离屏 WebView</strong> 中渲染好页面：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PrerenderManager</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> Map&lt;String, WebView&gt; prerenderCache = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">HashMap</span>&lt;&gt;();
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 根据用户画像预渲染</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">prerender</span><span class="hljs-params">(String pageUrl, String preloadData)</span> {
        <span class="hljs-type">WebView</span> <span class="hljs-variable">offscreen</span> <span class="hljs-operator">=</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">WebView</span>(context);
        offscreen.loadUrl(<span class="hljs-string">"offline://index.html"</span>);
        
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 注入预加载数据并触发渲染</span>
        offscreen.evaluateJavascript(
            <span class="hljs-string">"window.__preloadData = "</span> + preloadData + <span class="hljs-string">"; app.render();"</span>,
            <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>
        );
        prerenderCache.put(pageUrl, offscreen);
    }
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 用户实际点击时，用已渲染的 WebView 替换</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">public</span> WebView <span class="hljs-title function_">getPrerendered</span><span class="hljs-params">(String pageUrl)</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> prerenderCache.remove(pageUrl);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-30">8.2 流式渲染（SSR + Streaming）</h3>
<p>服务端渲染首屏 HTML 并流式返回，App 侧边收边渲染：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-markdown" lang="markdown">服务端:
<span class="hljs-bullet">  1.</span> 生成骨架屏 → 立即返回
<span class="hljs-bullet">  2.</span> 生成首屏内容 → 追加返回
<span class="hljs-bullet">  3.</span> 生成交互 JS → 追加返回

App 侧:
  WebView 收到 chunk1 → 渲染骨架屏
  WebView 收到 chunk2 → 渲染首屏内容
  WebView 收到 chunk3 → 绑定事件
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-31">8.3 Native + H5 混合渲染</h3>
<p>对于重度页面，由 Native 渲染框架部分（标题栏、底部栏、固定元素），H5 只渲染核心内容区：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css">┌──────────────────────────┐
│  Native 标题栏            │  ← Native 渲染，秒出
├──────────────────────────┤
│                          │
│  <span class="hljs-selector-tag">H5</span> 内容区                │  ← <span class="hljs-selector-tag">H5</span> 离线包渲染
│                          │
├──────────────────────────┤
│  Native 底部栏            │  ← Native 渲染，秒出
└──────────────────────────┘
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-32">九、方案对比与选型建议</h2>






















































<table><thead><tr><th>方案</th><th>实现难度</th><th>秒开效果</th><th>维护成本</th><th>适用场景</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>WebView 预热池</strong></td><td>⭐ 低</td><td>减少 100~300ms</td><td>低</td><td>所有场景，必做</td></tr><tr><td><strong>离线包</strong></td><td>⭐⭐⭐ 中高</td><td><strong>消除网络 IO</strong></td><td>中</td><td>核心高频页面</td></tr><tr><td><strong>数据预请求</strong></td><td>⭐⭐ 中</td><td>减少接口耗时</td><td>低</td><td>接口耗时大的页面</td></tr><tr><td><strong>骨架屏</strong></td><td>⭐ 低</td><td>提升感知速度</td><td>低</td><td>所有场景，必做</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Service Worker</strong></td><td>⭐⭐ 中</td><td>减少重复资源</td><td>中</td><td>iOS/Android 高版本</td></tr><tr><td><strong>页面预渲染</strong></td><td>⭐⭐⭐ 高</td><td>几乎零延迟</td><td>高</td><td>高频固定路径</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h3 data-id="heading-33">推荐组合方案</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-markdown" lang="markdown">Level 1（基线）:
<span class="hljs-code">    WebView预热池 + 骨架屏 + 接口缓存
    投入：1~2人天，收益：首屏 ~800ms → ~500ms
</span>
Level 2（进阶）:
<span class="hljs-bullet">    +</span> 离线包 + 数据预请求
<span class="hljs-code">    投入：3~5人天，收益：首屏 ~500ms → ~200ms
</span>
Level 3（极致）:
<span class="hljs-bullet">    +</span> 页面预渲染 + Native混合渲染
<span class="hljs-code">    投入：5~10人天，收益：首屏 ~200ms → ~50ms（体感"秒开"）
</span></code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-34">十、踩坑与注意事项</h2>
<ol>
<li><strong>离线包体积控制</strong>：单包建议 &lt; 3MB，核心包 &lt; 500KB，避免下载耗时和存储压力</li>
<li><strong>WKWebView 限制</strong>：iOS WKWebView 不支持 <code>NSURLProtocol</code> 拦截（iOS 11+ 可用 <code>WKURLSchemeHandler</code>），只能拦截自定义 scheme 或使用代理方案</li>
<li><strong>跨域问题</strong>：本地文件加载可能触发跨域限制，建议统一使用自定义 scheme</li>
<li><strong>WebView 泄漏</strong>：预热池务必正确释放，否则导致内存泄漏</li>
<li><strong>首次访问仍是网络</strong>：用户首次访问时离线包可能未下载完，需要做好<strong>降级兜底</strong></li>
<li><strong>实时性要求页面</strong>：强实时性页面（如秒杀、竞价）不建议完全依赖离线包，应走 SSE/WebSocket 增量更新</li>
<li><strong>公共资源去重</strong>：多个离线包共用的 JS/CSS（如 Vue/React 框架），应抽离为"公共离线包"，各业务包声明依赖即可</li>
</ol>
<hr>
